<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { DateFieldRoot, type DateFieldRootEmits, type DateFieldRootProps, type SegmentPart, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';
import { DateFieldInput } from '.';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<DateFieldRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<DateFieldRootEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);

defineSlots<{
  /**
   * The date segments. Each one renders in a `DateFieldInput` unless you pass your own content.
   */
  default?: (props: {
    modelValue: DateFieldRootProps['modelValue'];
    segments: { part: SegmentPart; value: string }[];
    isInvalid: boolean;
  }) => unknown;
}>();
</script>

<template>
  <DateFieldRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="date-field"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-date-field"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps">
      <DateFieldInput
        v-for="(item, index) in slotProps.segments"
        :key="`${item.part}-${index}`"
        :part="item.part"
      >
        {{ item.value }}
      </DateFieldInput>
    </slot>
  </DateFieldRoot>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-date-field {
  display: inline-flex;
  height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background-color: var(--input);
  font-size: 1rem;
  padding-inline: 0.75rem;
}

@media (width >= 48rem) {
  .sigma-ui-date-field {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
}

.sigma-ui-date-field:focus-within {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.sigma-ui-date-field[data-invalid],
.sigma-ui-date-field[aria-invalid="true"] {
  border-color: var(--destructive);
}

.sigma-ui-date-field[data-disabled] {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.5;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { DateFieldInput, type DateFieldInputProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<DateFieldInputProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <DateFieldInput
    data-slot="date-field-input"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    :data-part="props.part"
    class="sigma-ui-date-field-input"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </DateFieldInput>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-date-field-input {
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  outline: none;
  padding-inline: 0.125rem;
}

.sigma-ui-date-field-input:focus {
  background-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-date-field-input[data-part="literal"] {
  padding-inline: 0;
}

.sigma-ui-date-field-input[data-disabled] {
  cursor: not-allowed;
}
</style>

export { default as DateField } from './DateField.vue';
export { default as DateFieldInput } from './DateFieldInput.vue';
